notes.description: A scoped rifle for picking people off at range, quicker between shots than a sniper rifle.
notes.range: Best within 60 m: full damage, 3 body shots. Down to 85 % (4 shots) by 150 m; reaches 220 m. Standard ballistics: by impact speed, the same distances.
notes.recoil: The legacy spread bloom (bloom per shot, cap, recovery per tick). With a family its spread comes from the family's accuracy; `maxBloom` still sets how long bots fire their bursts.
notes.group: The extended arsenal: every one fires differently. 3: rifles.
notes.model: The owner's Semi-Automatic Precision DMR (Meshy, owned; content/guns.json, 2026-11-28): 1.05 m, held copies a 50,000-triangle cut, the owner's Scope model on its rail (content/optics.json rifle_scope; aimed through the full-screen scope as before). The kit rifle is the fallback.
